principle: No legally usable, source-identified, fresh and verified data => no scored factor or executable prediction. Missing data stays missing and must never be fabricated, imputed, silently defaulted, or replaced by stale values.

absolute_invariants.TW_MARKET_SCOPE: Only instruments and rules explicitly supported by the Taiwan model may be analysed. Unsupported security types, special trading states or market-rule exceptions must be blocked rather than forced through the common-stock model.
absolute_invariants.LEGAL_SOURCE_ONLY: Every scored or predictive input must come from a source whose access and intended use are explicitly permitted. A public URL is not by itself a licence.
absolute_invariants.NO_IMPUTATION: A missing, failed, stale, mismatched or legally-unusable source remains null/unavailable. Never replace it with zero, a guessed value, another provider's unverified value, the previous period, a synthetic value, or a model estimate pretending to be observed data.
absolute_invariants.FACT_ESTIMATE_SEPARATION: Observed facts, deterministic derived values and model estimates must be separately identified. A model output must never be displayed as an observed market fact.
absolute_invariants.TRACEABILITY: Every observed number used in scoring or prediction must be traceable to source, dataset, data date/period and verification status.
absolute_invariants.EXACT_SCHEMA_ONLY: Scored structured data may be parsed only through registered exact field names/versioned schemas. Semantic guessing of unknown field names is forbidden.
absolute_invariants.FRESHNESS: Current-state outputs require the latest completed official trading session or latest required reporting period. Calendar-age tolerance must never relabel an old session as current.
absolute_invariants.PRICE_CROSS_CHECK: Price-based prediction requires same-security, same-session official close cross-check. Any mismatch blocks the prediction.
absolute_invariants.HISTORY_COMPLETENESS: Partial historical downloads cannot silently become a valid series. Each model has a minimum valid-bar requirement and abnormal gaps block the prediction.
absolute_invariants.NO_FAKE_CONFIDENCE: Do not display confidence, probability, win probability or success rate unless calibrated from a statistically valid out-of-sample test with sample size and method disclosed.
absolute_invariants.TAIWAN_MICROSTRUCTURE: All executable prices must obey Taiwan tick size, reference-price/price-limit rules, trading-session rules and active restrictions applicable to that security.
absolute_invariants.CORPORATE_ACTION_GATE: Ex-right/ex-dividend, capital reduction, split, new listing/no-limit periods or other reference-price discontinuities require explicit official adjustment or the price prediction is blocked.
absolute_invariants.ACTIVE_RISK_STATUS: Attention/disposition/suspension states must be valid for the target trading date. Unknown status is not a clean status.
absolute_invariants.ACCOUNTING_CLASS_GATE: General, financial, insurance, securities/futures, holding-company and mixed-industry statements may not be treated as interchangeable. Unknown class receives no sector-financial score.
absolute_invariants.MODEL_VALIDATION_GATE: A model whose out-of-sample status is FAIL or INSUFFICIENT must not be presented as a validated recommendation; at most it may be an explicitly unvalidated research estimate.
absolute_invariants.FAIL_CLOSED: When a required gate cannot be evaluated, the result is blocked. Unknown is never treated as pass.
absolute_invariants.RAW_REDISTRIBUTION: Raw official datasets may be mirrored publicly only when the specific dataset licence/authorisation permits redistribution and attribution obligations are satisfied.
absolute_invariants.AUDITABILITY: Model version, source status, data date and blockers/warnings must be visible or recoverable for every generated result.
absolute_invariants.BUY_HOLDING_SEPARATION: A buy-entry model and an existing-position exit model are different decisions. Short/mid/long structural support bands must never be shown as currently executable buy prices merely because they are below market.
absolute_invariants.TARGET_SESSION_BY_DATA_DATE: The model's target trading session is determined from the latest verified completed official session, not from the user's clock alone. Clock time only controls whether an order type is currently executable.
absolute_invariants.NEXT_SESSION_INPUT_COMPLETENESS: A new next-session plan may be generated only after the latest completed official session has advanced and every input required by that model for the target session has independently passed legal-source, schema, date and integrity checks. A scheduled refresh time is never proof that data is ready.
absolute_invariants.NO_INTRADAY_REPRICE_WITHOUT_LIVE_FEED: Without a legally licensed real-time or delayed market-data feed, StockLab must not create a revised same-day executable price after 09:00 or describe any stale/daily-close value as the current market price. The original plan may remain visible only as a labelled reference/audit record.
absolute_invariants.NO_UNBUYABLE_ENTRY_BANDS: A deep support level may be shown only as a wait/re-entry condition. It must not be labelled as a current buy recommendation unless the model can establish that the price is actionable for the target session.
absolute_invariants.POSITION_INPUT_PROVENANCE: Holding cost, shares and buy date are user-supplied facts. They must be labelled as user input and never inferred from market data.
absolute_invariants.EXIT_MODEL_SEPARATION: Exit timing must use the holder's cost basis, position size, holding duration, verified price structure and risk state. A former buy-entry band may not be renamed into an exit recommendation.
absolute_invariants.SCANNER_OBJECTIVE_SEPARATION: Momentum, growth, income and long-term total-return scanners are separate models with separate required factors and OOS validation. A single ranking must never be relabelled as multiple investment horizons or objectives.
absolute_invariants.TOP10_REASON_REQUIRED: Every TOP10 candidate must disclose at least two strategy-specific, source-traceable inclusion reasons and at least one material risk. A naked rank or score is insufficient.
absolute_invariants.DIVIDEND_TRUTH: Cash dividends, stock dividends, dividend yield, distribution year and ex-right/ex-dividend dates must come from licensed verified datasets. Missing or not-yet-announced dividend fields remain unavailable and must never be converted to zero or guessed dates.

provenance_classes.observed: Direct field from a legally permitted source after schema/date validation.
provenance_classes.user_observed: Value explicitly entered by the user, such as average cost, shares or buy date.
provenance_classes.derived: Deterministic calculation from identified observed/user-observed inputs; formula and input dates must be known.
provenance_classes.model_estimate: Forecast/decision output from verified inputs; never labelled as official data.
provenance_classes.unavailable: Missing, stale, legally blocked, schema-unknown or failed validation; never converted to a numeric factor.

official_website_only.rule: Do not automate-download or mirror website data unless the provider terms, an open-data listing, or a written agreement explicitly permits it.

real_time_or_delayed_trading_information.rule: Do not ingest or redistribute real-time/delayed trading information without the required exchange/provider agreement.

buy.purpose: Decide whether and how to enter the next applicable trading session from the latest verified completed official session.
forbidden: short/mid/long deep support bands presented as current buy prices
real-time wording without a licensed live feed
automatic switch to tomorrow solely because clock passed 09:00 or 13:30
same-day repricing after 09:00 without a licensed live/delayed feed
buy.time_rule: 08:30-09:00 controls whether a pre-open limit ROD plan is in its execution window. After 09:00 the same plan may remain visible only as a labelled reference/audit record; without a licensed live/delayed feed StockLab must not create a revised same-day executable price. A new next-session plan is generated only after the official latest completed-session date has advanced AND every model-required target-session input has passed its legal-source, schema, freshness and integrity gates.

refresh_policy.rule: These are retrieval attempts, not promises of availability. Plan readiness is determined by verified data dates and required-input completeness, never by the scheduled job time.

holding.purpose: Manage an existing position and decide hold/reduce/take-profit/exit conditions using the holder's own cost basis and verified market structure.
forbidden: renaming buy-entry bands as exit advice
claiming current unrealized P/L from stale or unverified price as if live

scanner.purpose: Find research candidates by investment objective, not by relabelling one generic ranking as short/mid/long.

strategies.momentum: Short-horizon price/volume/liquidity structure and Taiwan trading-risk state.
strategies.growth: Revenue acceleration, earnings/financial quality and valuation sanity for growth/swing candidates.
strategies.income: Verified cash/stock dividends, dividend yield, multi-year distribution history, earnings support and valuation.
strategies.total_return: Growth, financial quality, valuation and verified dividend contribution combined for long-term total return.

forbidden: same ordered list relabelled across strategies
dividend values inferred from missing fields

buy_session.order_rule: 08:30-09:00 limit ROD only. Outside that window, a stored/modelled pre-open value is reference-only. No same-day repricing is allowed after 09:00 without a licensed live/delayed feed.

output_contract.missing_text: 資料未取得／未通過驗證

levels.B: company IR or two independent quality sources

news_events.rule: A headline alone must never alter a stock score. Missing event data must never be converted into 'no event'.
